page.overview:
Who is Darth Inexor?

Darth Inexor was a humanoid Sith Lord who was active during the reign of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire, Inexor had red eyes, gray-green skin, and a completely cybernetic body save for their head. Inexor's body was comprised of red and black armor with green glowing accents near the torso and face. Inexor sported four cybernetic arms and four additional smaller hook-like appendages. They wielded two red-bladed lightsabers with black hilts.

Darth Inexor was a character created for Red Fly Studio's video game Battle of the Sith Lords. Inexor's design was created by concept artist Thomas A. Szakolczay at some point prior to the game's cancellation in 2011.
